diagnostics: An unreadable ToUnicode map was ignored; embedded font mappings were used.
focused.visualCheck: Embedded Trebuchet glyphs and visible text closely match PDFium.

behavior: Recovery is restricted to Identity-H/V composite fonts with embedded TrueType Unicode mappings and a lexically unreadable ToUnicode stream containing no begin, end, or usecmap markers. Glyph selection preserves CID-to-glyph mapping; extraction uses existing embedded reverse mapping. Unmapped glyphs remain replacement characters. Font, extraction, and rendering expose the recovery diagnostic.
preservedChecks: Strict parsing, filter decoding, inherited-map validation, mapping validation, and allocation limits are unchanged.
limitations: Missing Unicode semantics are not reconstructed. Single-file timing is not throughput; no updated full PDF.js count is claimed.
